entities.summary: The Nabi Daniel Mosque, is a mosque and mausoleum, located in Alexandria, on the north coast of Egypt. The mosque was named in honour of Muhammad Daniyal al-Mawsili, a Kurdish Muslim scholar of the Shafi'i school who was buried in the mosque.
